newsitem.title: IRAQ: Tunisian minister in Baghdad to boost trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian minister in Baghdad to boost trade.

text.p: A Tunisian delegation led by Trade Minister Mondher Zenaidi is in Baghdad discussing ways to boost trade, the official Iraqi News Agency (INA) said on Saturday.
INA said Zenaidi had talks with Vice-President Taha Yassin Ramadan and Finance Minister Hikmat Ibrahim.
"Ramadan praised the national stand of the Tunisian people vis-a-vis the Iraqi people in standing against aggression and the embargo imposed on Iraq," INA said.
"The Tunisian trade minister stressed that the Tunisian people stood behind Iraq in its facing of the forces of American aggression and hegemony aiming at Iraq's unity and independence," it said.
Tunisian trade delegations have been visiting Iraq to obtain deals under the oil-for-food programme that became effective in December last year.
INA said representatives of Iraqi ministries of trade, finance, higher education and communications met with Zanaidi, who arrived in Baghdad on Friday.
